utterances.speaker: Cleo
utterances.text: Cleo: Tell me what the repair drive needs most, and I’ll check what we’ve got.

utterances.speaker: Gus
utterances.text: Gus: Thanks, Cleo — the fastest help would be checking loose shelves, leaky faucets, and any broken door hinges first. I can bring my tool kit over as soon as you say the word.

utterances.speaker: Uli
utterances.text: Uli: I can help a little, but I need to keep it modest right now. Just point me to what’s most needed.

utterances.speaker: Oren
utterances.text: Oren: Right, sorry—what we need most is nails, tarps, tape, and a few working tools. If you can, please check those first.

utterances.speaker: Pia
utterances.text: Pia: Could you bring nails, tarps, and tape first? If you can, please also check for any working tools so I can sort the rest.

utterances.speaker: Bo
utterances.text: Bo: Sure, I can bring nails, tarps, and tape first. I’ll also check for any working tools and bring what I find.

utterances.speaker: Sam
utterances.text: Sam: Sure thing — I’m happy to help with the repair drive. What do you need me to bring or do?

utterances.speaker: Ira
utterances.text: Ira: Please start with the leaky sink and the front door hinge—they’re the most urgent. I’m still making the rest of the list, so any donations or word you can spread would really help.

utterances.speaker: Kira
utterances.text: Kira: So just to confirm, we’re starting with the leaky sink and the front door hinge, right? I’m still putting the repair list together.

utterances.speaker: Opal
utterances.text: Opal: Yes — leaky sink and front door hinge are the starting points. Send me any other locations, and I’ll keep them noted for the repair drive.

utterances.speaker: Jules
utterances.text: Jules: I can still bring that tape and a sturdy box if it’d help—sounds like the drive’s really picking up.

utterances.speaker: Rey
utterances.text: Rey: That would help a lot, thanks. I’ll send over the locations I have for the repair drive.

utterances.speaker: Faye
utterances.text: Faye: Sure — I can send the repair drive details again and make sure everything is clear.

utterances.speaker: Dane
utterances.text: Dane: Sorry I’m late—what part of the repair drive needs the most help right now?

utterances.speaker: Nell
utterances.text: Nell: I’ve only heard bits and pieces—what’s the latest on the repair drive?

utterances.speaker: Tess
utterances.text: Tess: It’s picking up nicely—people have been dropping off tools and supplies all morning. If you’re heading over, I’d bring a little extra tape or a sturdy box if you have one.

utterances.speaker: Eli
utterances.text: Eli: That sounds good, Hana. I’ll list the locations clearly so we can keep the repair drive organized.

utterances.speaker: Hana
utterances.text: Hana: Thanks, Eli. If you send the locations, I’ll double-check them and keep everything organized.

utterances.speaker: Leo
utterances.text: Leo: We’re lining up volunteers and tools now, and I’m confirming the schedule today. I’ll send the updated details once it’s set.

utterances.speaker: Noah
utterances.text: Noah: Got it — I’ll keep an eye out for the update and bring some tape or a sturdy box if I can. Thanks for keeping me in the loop.

utterances.speaker: Quinn
utterances.text: Quinn: Absolutely — I’ll spread the word about the repair drive and get you the details too.

utterances.speaker: Rosa
utterances.text: Rosa: Thanks, Quinn — the biggest help right now is on Sunday at the community center, especially folks who can sort tools and help with repairs. I’ll send you the updated details so you can share them.

utterances.speaker: Mina
utterances.text: Mina: What are you short on most for the repair drive?

utterances.speaker: Vik
utterances.text: Vik: We’re mostly short on tools and a few basic supplies right now. I’ve been telling folks we need a little of everything, but those two are the biggest gaps.
